conventions.home_line: the line the HOME side lays, as a book prints it: negative = home favoured
conventions.clv_points: points the market moved toward the side the model leaned, from the recorded quote to the close; positive = the market came to the model
conventions.ats: model side vs the CLOSE, graded on the final margin: side = home when the model line is below the closing home line
